working_definition: Early-dataset (0-24h APF, 0h/12h/24h) cluster typed by the authors as Mi15; cluster is composed primarily of developing Mi15 neurons (immature).
searches_performed: OLS4 REST search fbbt "immature" medulla/transmedullary/amacrine terms

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the medullary intrinsic neuron Mi15 (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the D/BarHI temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: Authors' typing taken at face value; stage 0-24h APF so the immature term immature medulla intrinsic neuron Mi15 is the matching developing form.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Medulla intrinsic unicolumnar neuron whose primary neurite splits in the M1 layer, sending vertical branches as far as the M7 layer (Takemura et al., 2013; Takemura et al., 2015; Kind et al., 2021). A process also extends from the distal medulla into the first optic chiasma, where it receives around half of its photoreceptor input (Kind et al., 2021). In central columns, these cells selectively receive input from R8, rather than R7 photoreceptors, but selectivity is not maintained in Mi15 cells of the dorsal rim area (Kind et al., 2021). It seems to be both cholinergic and dopaminergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature (adult) form; cluster is 0-24h APF so the immature term is used.
